narrative.overview:
ARGOS is a vigil, not a dashboard. The whole surface is a single warm material, cream, with the Odyssey carried by three devices and nothing else: Cinzel capitals for titles, a thin gold Greek-key meander as the only ornament, and a glaze-dark band where the story is told. Everything that does work (body copy, labels, buttons, inputs) is set in Atkinson Hyperlegible at a 20px base, because the readers are often anxious adult children on a phone and, sometimes, the older parent with low vision. The theme is a layer over clarity, never a puzzle.

The system is flat and bordered. Surfaces sit on the cream ground without shadows; structure comes from 2px rules in glaze or gold and from the meander strip that separates regions (hero from body, header from app, the top of the sign-in card). Colour is rationed: terracotta appears only on the primary action and the step numerals, aegean only on links and focus, gold only as hairline and the one headline set on glaze. The states of a dose (olive taken, soft red missed, bare cream upcoming) are the only other colours that carry meaning.

Motion is a single authored entrance: the hero copy rises, the gold "day" line draws once, the dose markers settle. After that, nothing moves except hover and focus, and all of it stops under reduced motion (the hero video pauses too).
keyCharacteristics: One warm ground (cream) with one dark band (glaze); no white page, no grey chrome.
Cinzel Bold is reserved for h1, h2 and the wordmark; every other word is Atkinson Hyperlegible.
Ornament is a single 14px gold meander strip, horizontal or vertical, and a 3px gold wave as the day track.
Flat surfaces, 2px borders, square cards; the only shadow is a soft lift under the primary button.
Deep colour variants exist purely for WCAG AA on cream; the brand values are the owner's.
One entrance animation, exponential ease-out, then stillness.

rules.name: The Deep-For-Text Rule
rules.body: Terracotta, aegean, olive and red are fills; their `-deep` partner is the text or the only version that may touch cream as a small element. Never set body-size text in a base brand colour on cream.

rules.name: The Hairline Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is ornament: strokes of 2–3px (meander, wave, rules, the wordmark ring) and one headline on glaze. It is never a fill, never a button, never body text.

rules.name: The One Terracotta Rule
rules.body: Terracotta-deep marks the primary action on a screen and the numbered steps leading to it. Two filled terracotta buttons in one viewport is a defect.

rules.name: The Cinzel Ration Rule
rules.body: Cinzel is for h1, h2, the wordmark and the step numerals. Any h3 or smaller is Atkinson Bold. No Cinzel in body, buttons, labels or navigation.

rules.name: The Twenty Rule
rules.body: The root font size is 20px and nothing user-facing drops below 0.95rem (19px). Inputs are 60px tall. Reduce size by stepping the ramp, never by shrinking the root.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only the primary button casts a shadow. Cards, inputs, navigation and the header stay flat; if an element needs separation, give it a 2px border or set it on glaze.

dos: Do keep the page cream and reserve glaze fills for one story band per page, topped and tailed by the meander.
Do set every text link in aegean-deep bold, and every error in red-deep with a recovery sentence.
Do use the `-deep` variant whenever a brand colour becomes text or a small mark on cream.
Do give every control at least 3rem height (buttons 3.5rem), a visible label above, and the 3px aegean focus outline.
Do structure with 2px rules (glaze for lists, gold for ornament) and square frames; round only controls (0.375rem) and status markers (circles).
Do keep one filled terracotta-deep button per viewport and let "Sign in" be a quiet link beside it.
Do wrap every entrance animation in `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` and use the expo ease-out.
donts: Don't set Cinzel below h2 (except the step numerals and the wordmark), or use it in buttons, labels or navigation.
Don't add shadows to cards, inputs, nav or headers; the primary button is the only element that lifts.
Don't fill anything with gold or set gold body text; gold is a 2–3px stroke or a headline on glaze.
Don't introduce white surfaces, grey chrome, parchment textures or fake-ancient body fonts; cream and glaze are the whole material.
Don't use base terracotta, aegean, olive or red as text on cream.
Don't replace the custom stroke icons with an icon font or a third-party set, or add glyphs that are not in `Icons.tsx`.
Don't add a second ornament (laurel, column, vase texture) without a system change; the build carries only the meander and the wave.
